notes.title: March 14 update
notes.notes:
1. Game pad support
-In the game settings, the auto targeting option is added to automatically look at the enemies of the game pad, vibration intensity and in -game play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809605/c63e2d3a85e5122e260d758f3c24f76d2ef27fcf.png[/img]

-The current auto targeting does not apply to skills to the mouse point. (EX giant baby, carpet bombing, etc.)
-I will improve auto targeting later to provide an option for Trinity Survivors.
-Customization of the game pad will also be provided later through the update.

2. Add a single stage difficulty function
-You can adjust the difficulty level of the stage on the screening screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809605/3df9112aebcc2c257c12392c6af879c38a3e4a16.png[/img]

-The difficulty level controls the attack power of the monster, the frequency of attack and the speed of movement.
-The higher the difficulty, the higher the goods and the final score, and the lower the difficulty, the lower the goods and the score.
-The initial rewards and unlocks proceed regardless of difficulty.
-The difficulty appears from 4 stages and is composed of 4 stages except for the final stage, the final stage. (Easy, normal, Hard, very Hard)
-The final stage, Awakened threat, offers five difficulty levels: Easy, Normal, Hard, Very Hard, Hell.

3. Have a single stage with friends (BETA)
-The ability to join a single stage with friends has been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809605/11090dfd9eb269c4fca5ef29f449d3fcc2689dfe.png[/img]

-The BETA version is a new mode of multiplayer to invite Steam friends to clear the stage together.
-It can be proceeded from stage 4 to be with friends.
-The balance is automatically adjusted according to the growth difference, and the initial reward and release are performed normally even when cleared by two -person cooperation.
-There is no separate life gauge like a cooperative war, but the resurrection function is set to operate normal when death.
-When the level up and artifact is obtained, the game will be suspended for a certain period of time, and when everyone finishes the choice, the game will be resumed again.

4. Add 12 species of synergy skill growth
-There are 12 synergy skills that appear when certain characters came together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809605/4514d32df610307371d91931cbd35a6fa5e18c1d.png[/img]

Synergy skills are composed of skills that have a powerful additional effect.
-There are two synergy skill growth per character, and the update will add a variety of additional effects and new synergy skills.

5. Improved blood kill reward method
-The method in which existing usable and unusable artifacts appear with a certain probability when obtaining a Blood Kill reward box will be modified.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809605/5bf75b267bcb17549e60758f86e2388f5947d5e2.png[/img]

-Usability artifacts appear first when receiving Blood Kill rewards, but you can replace them with regular artifacts by pressing the Replace with Unusable Artifacts button below.
-You can obtain it by selecting usability or non-usability depending on the situation.
-When resetting an artifact, only the currently selected artifact is reset.

6. Add new artifacts
-fruit of awakening (Rare): It appears without any unlock conditions, and drops a Legendary Growth Scroll when acquired.
-Parchment of Deep Thousht (common): It appears without any unlock conditions and provides 15% additional experience gain and 3 level-up resets.

7. Artifact modifications
-Ancient parchment (common): The amount of experience gained is changed from 30% to 15%.
-Isrelda's blessing: Stamina recovery per 1 blood kill (1 second cooldown) is changed from 3 recovery per blood kill (cool time 2 seconds).
-Blessing of the Forest Goddess: 20% reduction in damage is added. Make the character invincible for 5 seconds every 30 seconds.

8. Tana's blacksmith price modification
-The purchase price of legendary artifacts will be modified from 50000 gold to 20000 gold.

9. Fixed tactical training costs
-The cost of secondary tactical training is changed from 5000 gold and 2000 crystals to 3000 gold and 1000 crystals.

notes.title: March 5 update
notes.notes:
1. Change of skill training cost payment method
-It is changed by selecting the skills you want and purchasing at a fixed amount of skill training in the existing Gacha skill training.
-The cost is a common 20 bloodstone, a Uncommon 30 bloodstone and a rare 40 bloodstones.

2. Artifact modification
-Enhanced Throwing Knife: The number of daggers increases to eight and the size is reduced.
-Glass Cannon: Modified from 30% to 25% critical damage. Modified from 70% to 50% of the critical damage when it is 30% or less
-Enhanced Glass Cannon: Modified from 30% to 25% critical damage. Modified from 70% to 50% of the critical damage when it is 50% or less
-Berserker's Belt: When you have more than 30% of your health, you modify it from 5 seconds to 10 seconds.
-Enhanced Berserker's Belt: When you have more than 40% of your health, you modify it from 5 seconds to 10 seconds.
-Bloody Pendant: Bloodkill occurrence conditions 30 to 20 times modified
-Enhanced Bloody Pendant: Bloodkill occurrence conditions 30 to 20 times modified

3. Stage:Tainted Forest modification
-Fix the spawn distance of the GoblinSniper not to be too far away

4. Effect modification
-The visibility of some of the effects of the character and monster has been enhanced.

notes.title: February 26 update
notes.notes:
1. Add new artifacts
-There are 12 artifacts for character -only artifacts
-Ap addition of 8 artifacts
-The artifact can be purchased in Tana's Forge
-Tana's Forge is unlocked after clearing the Orc Outpost. (Existing users must also be cleared once.)
-The artifacts of the flame controller and the Tazer field are not currently strengthened due to the current magic crystal. (Scheduled to proceed later)

2. Crystal of tactical training centers
-You can grow the number of artifact resets by two additional levels in the tactical training camp
-Revised cost of consumption of attack damage increase phase 15-17 changed from 2000 crystals to 1000 crystals
-Revised cost of consumption of Maximum Health increase phase 15-17 changed from 2000 crystals to 1000 crystals

3. Artifact modification
-Bloodkill conditions of Tyrant's Helmet have been modified from 10 to 5.
-The reduction of cooldown of Enhanced Tyrant's Helmet has been revised from 50% to 5%.
-The usage artifact gravity field has been modified.
-The firing speed of the gravitational field increases.
-The strength of the gravitational field increases.
-The cooldown decreases from 50 seconds to 35 seconds.

4. Dash skill
Fixed an issue that some of the skills triggered by the dash were not included in the damage increase.
-When the assault, the size of the collision box was resized to fit the character size.
-The basic cooldown of Dash has been modified from 8 to 7 seconds.

5. Art Modification
-The effect visibility of the five -star ax of the Orc Vanguard Chieftain has improved.
-A part of the artifact icon has been replaced with improved images.
-The effects of some skills have been modified to improve visibility.

notes.title: February 19 update
notes.notes:
1. Monster Stat Adjustments
   - Decrease the health and attack power of orcs in the Deathbloom Domain stage by 10%
   - Decrease the health of the Deathbloom Domain boss by 10%
   - Decrease the health and attack power of orcs in the Orc Garrison area by 10%
   - Decrease the health and attack power of orcs in the Orc Forward Base by 10%
   - Increase the attack timing of all orc shield bearers appearing in stages by 10%
   - Decrease the projectile speed of all orc shield bearers appearing in stages by 10%
   - Increase the attack delay of all orc veterans by 60-100%
   - Increase the attack delay of Orc Bomb Officers by 30-50%
   - Decrease the health of Balphur, the Phase 2 boss of Awakened Threat, by 20%

2. Stage Adjustments
   - Remove lasers from the Orc Forward Base stage
   - Remove the poison swamp Rafflesia from the Fourfold Eyes Stage
   - Remove lasers from the Siege Weapon stage
   - Change the siege weapon type to normal in the Surveillance Device stage
   - Remove axe throwers from the Surveillance Device stage
   - Remove orc shamans from the Surveillance Device stage
   - Remove lasers from the Boiling Ground stage
   - Change the siege weapon type to normal in the Boiling Ground stage
   - Adjust the score multiplier in the Fourfold Eyes Stage to normal levels
   - Decrease the attack power of orcs in the Challenge stage by 10%

3. Medal Adjustments
   - Change the basic option of the Berserk Medal to increase party-wide attack power by 10%
   - Adjust the universal border of the Berserk Medal to increase attack power against normal orcs from 20% to 30%
   - Adjust the extermination border of the Berserk Medal to increase attack power against commander orcs from 20% to 30%

4. Artifact Adjustments
   - Increase the base appearance rate of enhanced artifacts from 5% to 10%
   - Fix the dash distance of Seina's Feather and Seina's Feather (Enhanced) to 10%
   - Fix the dash distance of Seina's Boots and Seina's Boots (Enhanced) to 10%
   - Adjust the shield generation position of the Enhanced Excalibur to the center of the character. Change the shield duration from 5 seconds to 3 seconds

5. Multiplayer Adjustments
   - Increase the range for reviving friends from 2M to 3M
   - Change the revival time for friends from 5 seconds to 3 seconds

notes.title: February 15 update content
notes.notes:
- When the curse of the cursed sword was lifted at the Blood Altar, it has been modified to also display the sword as unbound at the Blood Altar.
- The issue where the tooltip for Bloodkill in the Fallen Angel Office was being cut off has been fixed.
- The gauge penalty received when hit during a charging skill has been reduced by half.
- The issue where the health recovery of special heavy armor occasionally did not occur during cooperative play has been fixed.
